title: A photo check that lands after its 15s give-up leaves its JPEG on disk
trigger: Attach a large HEIC/JXL photo whose decode takes over 15 seconds; the give-up timer settles the read as FileOnly, then the worker finishes and writes a JPEG into quill-send-photos.
effect: finish_media_check returns early on the stale job and drops MediaCheck::Jpeg(path) without removing the file, so each late result leaves a temp JPEG until the scratch dir is cleaned.
fix: Remove the Jpeg file when finish() reports a stale job (as video_preview does), or have the stage own the file.
